name: Knee Dislocation
definition: Disruption of tibiofemoral alignment, often involving multiple ligaments and carrying high risk of popliteal artery and peroneal nerve injury.

typical: Gross deformity or spontaneously reduced knee

core: Immediate vascular assessment including ABI pathway

investigations.principle: Radiographs confirm alignment; CT angiography is indicated according to vascular findings/protocol; MRI defines ligament injury after stabilization.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Normal pulses do not completely exclude vascular injury; structured vascular assessment is essential.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu-Sandhi displacement phenotype is secondary to emergency vascular management.

patientEducation.summary: Disruption of tibiofemoral alignment, often involving multiple ligaments and carrying high risk of popliteal artery and peroneal nerve injury.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, sepsis, pathological instability or other listed red flags.
